function inputCheckednessCase(variant, includeGroups=true) {
 const checks={},make=(type='checkbox',name='')=>{const x=document.createElement('input');x.type=type;x.name=name;return x;};
 const box=make();checks.initial=box.checked===false&&box.defaultChecked===false&&box.indeterminate===false;
 box.defaultChecked=true;checks.cleanDefault=box.checked&&box.hasAttribute('checked');box.defaultChecked=false;checks.cleanRemoval=!box.checked&&!box.hasAttribute('checked');
 box.checked=true;checks.dirtyValue=box.checked&&!box.defaultChecked&&!box.hasAttribute('checked');box.defaultChecked=true;box.defaultChecked=false;checks.dirtyPreserved=box.checked&&!box.defaultChecked;
 box.checked=false;box.defaultChecked=true;checks.dirtyFalse=!box.checked&&box.defaultChecked;box.indeterminate=true;checks.independent=box.indeterminate&&!box.checked;box.checked=true;checks.indeterminatePreserved=box.indeterminate&&box.checked;
 box.indeterminate=0;box.checked=null;checks.booleanConversion=!box.indeterminate&&!box.checked;box.checked={};box.indeterminate='';checks.truthy=box.checked&&!box.indeterminate;
 const text=make('text');text.checked=true;text.indeterminate=true;text.type='checkbox';checks.typePreserved=text.checked&&text.indeterminate&&!text.defaultChecked;
 const attr=make();attr.setAttributeNS(null,'checked','false');checks.namespaced=attr.checked&&attr.defaultChecked;attr.getAttributeNode('checked').value='';checks.attrValue=attr.checked;attr.removeAttributeNode(attr.getAttributeNode('checked'));checks.attrRemoval=!attr.checked&&!attr.defaultChecked;
 const named=make();const checked=document.createAttribute('checked');named.setAttributeNode(checked);checks.attrAttach=named.checked&&named.defaultChecked;named.checked=false;named.removeAttributeNode(checked);named.setAttributeNode(checked);checks.attrDirty=!named.checked&&named.defaultChecked;
 const observed=make();let events=0;observed.addEventListener('input',()=>events++);observed.addEventListener('change',()=>events++);const observer=new MutationObserver(()=>{});observer.observe(observed,{attributes:true});observed.checked=true;observed.indeterminate=true;checks.noRecords=observer.takeRecords().length===0;checks.noEvents=events===0;observed.defaultChecked=true;checks.defaultRecord=observer.takeRecords().length===1;observer.disconnect();
 const get=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'checked').get;let rejected=false;try{get.call(document.createElement('div'))}catch(e){rejected=e instanceof TypeError}checks.receiver=rejected;
 const descriptor=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'checked');checks.descriptor=descriptor.enumerable&&descriptor.configurable&&!Object.hasOwn(box,'checked');
 if(!includeGroups)return checks;
 const holder=document.createElement('section');holder.id='checked-'+variant;document.body.append(holder);const a=make('radio','group'),b=make('radio','group');holder.append(a,b);a.checked=true;b.checked=true;checks.radioExclusive=!a.checked&&b.checked;b.checked=false;checks.radioEmpty=!a.checked&&!b.checked;
 const cleanA=make('radio','clean'),cleanB=make('radio','clean');holder.append(cleanA,cleanB);cleanA.defaultChecked=true;checks.radioDefault=cleanA.checked&&!cleanB.checked;cleanB.checked=false;cleanB.defaultChecked=true;checks.radioDefaultDirty=cleanA.checked&&!cleanB.checked;cleanB.checked=true;checks.radioCurrent=!cleanA.checked&&cleanB.checked;cleanA.defaultChecked=false;cleanA.defaultChecked=true;checks.radioDeselectedDirty=!cleanA.checked&&cleanB.checked;a.checked=true;
 const c=make('radio','other');holder.append(c);c.checked=true;checks.distinctName=a.checked&&c.checked;c.name='group';checks.nameTransfer=!a.checked&&c.checked;
 const empty1=make('radio'),empty2=make('radio');holder.append(empty1,empty2);empty1.checked=true;empty2.checked=true;checks.emptyNames=empty1.checked&&empty2.checked;
 const detached=make('radio','group');detached.checked=true;checks.detachedRoot=detached.checked&&c.checked;holder.append(detached);checks.connectedWinner=detached.checked&&!c.checked;
 const isolated=document.createDocumentFragment(),d=make('radio','group'),e=make('radio','group');isolated.append(d,e);d.checked=true;e.checked=true;checks.fragmentGroup=!d.checked&&e.checked&&detached.checked;
 const form1=document.createElement('form'),form2=document.createElement('form');form1.id='form-a-'+variant;form2.id='form-b-'+variant;holder.append(form1,form2);const f=make('radio','owned'),g=make('radio','owned');form1.append(f);form2.append(g);f.checked=true;g.checked=true;checks.distinctForms=f.checked&&g.checked;form1.append(g);checks.movedForm=!f.checked&&g.checked;
 const external=make('radio','owned');external.setAttribute('form',form1.id);holder.append(external);external.checked=true;checks.explicitOwner=external.checked&&!g.checked;external.setAttribute('form',form2.id);g.checked=true;checks.ownerChange=g.checked&&external.checked;
 const shadowHost=document.createElement('div');holder.append(shadowHost);const shadow=shadowHost.attachShadow({mode:'open'}),s1=make('radio','group'),s2=make('radio','group');shadow.append(s1,s2);s1.checked=true;s2.checked=true;checks.shadowGroup=!s1.checked&&s2.checked&&detached.checked;
 const parsed=document.createElement('div');parsed.innerHTML='<input type=radio name=parsed checked><input type=radio name=parsed checked>';holder.append(parsed);checks.parsedLast=!parsed.children[0].checked&&parsed.children[1].checked&&parsed.children[0].defaultChecked&&parsed.children[1].defaultChecked;
 const changing=make('checkbox','parsed');changing.checked=true;parsed.append(changing);changing.type='radio';checks.typeGroup=changing.checked&&!parsed.children[1].checked;
 const caseName=make('radio','Group');holder.append(caseName);caseName.checked=true;checks.caseSensitive=caseName.checked&&detached.checked;
 const replaced=document.createElement('div');holder.append(replaced);replaced.innerHTML='<input type=radio name=replaced checked>';const oldReplaced=replaced.firstChild;replaced.innerHTML='<input type=radio name=replaced checked>';checks.replacedDetached=oldReplaced.checked&&replaced.firstChild.checked;const oldText=replaced.firstChild;replaced.textContent='cleared';const afterText=make('radio','replaced');replaced.append(afterText);afterText.checked=true;checks.textDetached=oldText.checked&&afterText.checked;
 const ownerRadio=make('radio','reowned'),noOwner=make('radio','reowned');ownerRadio.setAttribute('form',form2.id);holder.append(ownerRadio,noOwner);ownerRadio.checked=true;noOwner.checked=true;checks.beforeOwnerId=ownerRadio.checked&&noOwner.checked;form2.id='renamed-'+variant;checks.ownerIdTransfer=ownerRadio.checked&&!noOwner.checked;
 const defaults=document.createElement('div');defaults.innerHTML='<input type=radio name=defaults checked><input type=radio name=defaults checked>';holder.append(defaults);const firstDefault=defaults.firstChild;firstDefault.defaultChecked=false;firstDefault.defaultChecked=true;checks.parsedDeselectedDirty=!firstDefault.checked&&defaults.lastChild.checked;
 const noForm=make('radio','no-form'),specified=make('radio','no-form');form1.append(noForm,specified);specified.setAttribute('form','missing-'+variant);noForm.checked=true;specified.checked=true;checks.missingFormOwner=noForm.checked&&specified.checked;
 const detachedForm=document.createElement('form'),detachedOther=document.createElement('form'),formFragment=document.createDocumentFragment();detachedForm.id='detached-form-'+variant;detachedOther.id='detached-other-'+variant;formFragment.append(detachedForm,detachedOther);const detachedOwned=make('radio','detached-owned'),detachedPeer=make('radio','detached-owned');detachedOwned.setAttribute('form',detachedOther.id);detachedForm.append(detachedOwned,detachedPeer);detachedOwned.checked=true;detachedPeer.checked=true;checks.detachedFormFallback=!detachedOwned.checked&&detachedPeer.checked;
 const foreign=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','form');foreign.id='foreign-'+variant;holder.append(foreign);const foreignOwned=make('radio','foreign'),foreignPeer=make('radio','foreign');foreignOwned.setAttribute('form',foreign.id);holder.append(foreignOwned,foreignPeer);foreignOwned.checked=true;foreignPeer.checked=true;checks.foreignFormIgnored=!foreignOwned.checked&&foreignPeer.checked;
 holder.remove();checks.detachedPreservation=detached.checked&&s2.checked&&changing.checked;
 return checks;
}
